paras.text: From this blessed verse it becomes known that true Muslims are those people whose attitude is this, that neither do they spend money extravagantly in luxury, gambling, drinking and the customs of weddings, nor, to show off their grandeur beyond their status, squander wealth on food, house, dress, decoration and adornment; nor is their condition this, that like a money-worshipping man they keep hoarding money, i.e. neither eat themselves nor fulfil the needs of their family according to their capacity, nor spend with large-heartedness in any good cause.

paras.text: Ending of the concentration of wealth (Elimination of Concentration of Wealth)
paras.urdu: ارتکازِ دولت کا خاتمہ (Elimination of Concentration of Wealth)
paras.pashto: د شتمنۍ د تمرکز پای (Elimination of Concentration of Wealth)

paras.text: Under the capitalist system, generally capitalist people (i.e. industrialists, traders, importers and landlords etc.), with the help of their capital and abundant profits, go on making their business wider and wider, because of which the wealth of the poor and middle classes, coming out of their hands, keeps being drawn towards the capitalist class, and in this way most of the wealth of society becomes collected and concentrated with the capitalist class, whereas on the other side middle-grade people, salaried and fixed-income people go on becoming poorer and poorer. Thus the wealth becoming limited and concentrated in a few hands is called the problem of the concentration of wealth, which has many economic, social, moral and political disadvantages. Islam has forbidden wealth to become concentrated in a few hands, as becomes known from the following blessed verse: (Translation) “so that that (property) does not keep circulating only among your wealthy ones.” (Al-Hashr: 7)
paras.urdu: سرمایہ داری نظام کے تحت عام طور پر سرمایہ دار لوگ (یعنی صنعت کار، تاجر، امپورٹر اور زمیندار وغیرہ) اپنے سرمائے اور کثیر منافع کی مدد سے اپنے کاروبار کو وسیع سے وسیع تر کرتے جاتے ہیں جس کے باعث غریب اور متوسط طبقوں کی دولت ان کے ہاتھوں سے نکل نکل کر سرمایہ دار طبقے کے پاس کھنچی چلی جاتی ہے اور یوں معاشرہ کی بیشتر دولت سرمایہ دار طبقے کے پاس جمع اور مرتکز ہو جاتی ہے، جبکہ دوسری طرف درمیانے درجے کے لوگ، تنخواہ دار اور معینہ آمدنی والے غریب سے غریب تر ہوتے جاتے ہیں۔ یوں دولت کا چند ہاتھوں کے پاس محدود اور مرتکز ہو جانے کو ارتکازِ دولت کا مسئلہ کہا جاتا ہے۔ جس کے بہت سے معاشی، سماجی، اخلاقی اور سیاسی نقصانات ہیں۔ اسلام نے دولت کو چند ہاتھوں میں مرتکز ہونے کو منع فرمایا ہے، جیسا کہ ذیل کی آیت مبارکہ سے پتہ چلتا ہے: (ترجمہ) تاکہ وہ (مال) تمہارے مالداروں ہی کے درمیان گردش نہ کرتا رہے۔ (الحشر: 7)

paras.text: In this verse the Holy Quran has stated an important principle, according to which the basic rule of the economic policy of Islamic society and government was settled, that the circulation of wealth should be general in the whole society. It should not be that property keeps circulating only among wealthy people, because of which the rich become richer day by day and the poor poorer day by day.

paras.pashto: په دې آیت کې قرآن مجید یو مهم اصل بیان کړ، چې له مخې یې د اسلامي ټولنې او حکومت د اقتصادي پالیسۍ بنسټیزه قاعده دا وټاکل شوه چې د شتمنۍ دوران باید په ټوله ټولنه کې عام وي. داسې دې نه وي چې مال یوازې د شتمنو خلکو ترمنځ وګرځي، چې له امله یې شتمن ورځ تر بلې لا شتمن او بېوزله ورځ تر بلې لا بېوزله شي.

paras.text: To give practical shape to this basic economic principle of the Holy Quran Islam has taken many measures, e.g.:
paras.urdu: قرآن مجید کے اس بنیادی معاشی اصول کو عملی شکل دینے کے لئے اسلام نے کئی اقدامات کئے ہیں۔ مثلاً:
paras.pashto: د قرآن مجید د دې بنسټیز اقتصادي اصل د عملي کولو لپاره اسلام ګڼ ګامونه پورته کړي، لکه:

paras.text: ☆ Interest has been made haram. ☆ Zakat has been made obligatory. ☆ It has been ordered to take out khums from the spoils of war. ☆ Voluntary charities and alms have been emphasised. ☆ Such forms of different kinds of expiations have been proposed by which the direction of the flow of wealth is turned towards the poor classes of society. ☆ Such a law of inheritance has been made that the wealth left by every deceased person spreads in as wide a circle as possible. ☆ Miserliness has been declared a moral evil. ☆ Rich people have been told that in their property there is the right of the one who asks and the deprived, which they should pay considering it their right, not as charity.

paras.pashto: ☆ سود حرام شوی. ☆ زکات فرض شوی. ☆ د غنیمت له مالونو د خمس د ایستلو امر شوی. ☆ پر نفلي صدقو او خیرات ټینګار شوی. ☆ د بېلابېلو ډولونو کفارو داسې بڼې وړاندیز شوې چې له هغو د شتمنۍ د بهیر لوری د ټولنې بېوزلو طبقو ته واړول شي. ☆ د میراث داسې قانون جوړ شوی چې د هر مړه شوي کس پاتې شوې شتمني په تر ټولو پراخه کړۍ کې خپره شي. ☆ بخل اخلاقي بدي ګڼل شوی. ☆ شتمنو خلکو ته ویل شوي چې د هغوی په مال کې د سوالګر او بې‌برخي حق دی، چې باید د خیرات په توګه نه، بلکې د هغوی حق ګڼلو سره ورکړل شي.

paras.text: Simplicity and economy, and patience and contentment (Austerity and Self-Contentment)
paras.urdu: سادگی و کفایت اور صبر و قناعت (Austerity and Self-Contentment):
paras.pashto: ساده‌ګي او سپما، او صبر او قناعت (Austerity and Self-Contentment)

paras.pashto: د ټولو خلکو عاید، شتمني او مالي حالت یو شان نه وي، بلکې ځینې بې‌وزله او تنګلاسي وي او ځینې هوسا او شتمن. لکه څنګه چې د خلکو په بدني ځواک، ذهني وړتیا، زده‌کړه او روزنه او تخنیکي هنر کې توپیر وي، همداسې د هغوی په عاید او شتمنۍ کې هم توپیر … (په ۲۸۳ مخ دوام)

(continued from p.281) … give.” (At-Tawbah: 34) Instead of extravagance and miserliness, moderation in spending has been urged. In the Holy Quran it has been said thus: (Translation) “Those who, when they spend, neither waste nor are miserly, but rather their spending remains established in moderation between both extremes.” (Al-Furqan: 67)

From this blessed verse it becomes known that true Muslims are those people whose attitude is this, that neither do they spend money extravagantly in luxury, gambling, drinking and the customs of weddings, nor, to show off their grandeur beyond their status, squander wealth on food, house, dress, decoration and adornment; nor is their condition this, that like a money-worshipping man they keep hoarding money, i.e. neither eat themselves nor fulfil the needs of their family according to their capacity, nor spend with large-heartedness in any good cause.

The prohibition of improper spending and extravagance is evident from these blessed verses: (Translation) “And do not cross the limit (in spending); indeed Allah does not like those who cross the limit (i.e. extravagant people).” (Al-An’am: 141) “Do not spend wastefully; extravagant people are the brothers of the devils.” (Surah Bani Isra’il: 26, 27)

Ending of the concentration of wealth (Elimination of Concentration of Wealth)

Under the capitalist system, generally capitalist people (i.e. industrialists, traders, importers and landlords etc.), with the help of their capital and abundant profits, go on making their business wider and wider, because of which the wealth of the poor and middle classes, coming out of their hands, keeps being drawn towards the capitalist class, and in this way most of the wealth of society becomes collected and concentrated with the capitalist class, whereas on the other side middle-grade people, salaried and fixed-income people go on becoming poorer and poorer. Thus the wealth becoming limited and concentrated in a few hands is called the problem of the concentration of wealth, which has many economic, social, moral and political disadvantages. Islam has forbidden wealth to become concentrated in a few hands, as becomes known from the following blessed verse: (Translation) “so that that (property) does not keep circulating only among your wealthy ones.” (Al-Hashr: 7)

In this verse the Holy Quran has stated an important principle, according to which the basic rule of the economic policy of Islamic society and government was settled, that the circulation of wealth should be general in the whole society. It should not be that property keeps circulating only among wealthy people, because of which the rich become richer day by day and the poor poorer day by day.

To give practical shape to this basic economic principle of the Holy Quran Islam has taken many measures, e.g.:

☆ Interest has been made haram. ☆ Zakat has been made obligatory. ☆ It has been ordered to take out khums from the spoils of war. ☆ Voluntary charities and alms have been emphasised. ☆ Such forms of different kinds of expiations have been proposed by which the direction of the flow of wealth is turned towards the poor classes of society. ☆ Such a law of inheritance has been made that the wealth left by every deceased person spreads in as wide a circle as possible. ☆ Miserliness has been declared a moral evil. ☆ Rich people have been told that in their property there is the right of the one who asks and the deprived, which they should pay considering it their right, not as charity.

Simplicity and economy, and patience and contentment (Austerity and Self-Contentment)

The income, wealth and financial condition of all people is not alike, but rather some are bankrupt and in straitened circumstances and some well-off and rich. Just as in people’s physical strength, mental ability, education and training and technical skill there is a difference, in the same way in their income and wealth too there is a difference … (continued on p.283)

بے جا خرچ اور اسراف کی ممانعت ان آیاتِ مبارکہ سے ظاہر ہوتی ہے: (ترجمہ) اور (خرچ میں) حد سے نہ گزرو کہ اللہ حد سے گزرنے والوں (فضول خرچ لوگوں) کو پسند نہیں کرتا۔ (الانعام: 141) فضول خرچی نہ کرو، فضول خرچ لوگ شیطانوں کے بھائی ہیں۔ (سورۃ بنی اسرائیل: 26، 27)

ارتکازِ دولت کا خاتمہ (Elimination of Concentration of Wealth)

سرمایہ داری نظام کے تحت عام طور پر سرمایہ دار لوگ (یعنی صنعت کار، تاجر، امپورٹر اور زمیندار وغیرہ) اپنے سرمائے اور کثیر منافع کی مدد سے اپنے کاروبار کو وسیع سے وسیع تر کرتے جاتے ہیں جس کے باعث غریب اور متوسط طبقوں کی دولت ان کے ہاتھوں سے نکل نکل کر سرمایہ دار طبقے کے پاس کھنچی چلی جاتی ہے اور یوں معاشرہ کی بیشتر دولت سرمایہ دار طبقے کے پاس جمع اور مرتکز ہو جاتی ہے، جبکہ دوسری طرف درمیانے درجے کے لوگ، تنخواہ دار اور معینہ آمدنی والے غریب سے غریب تر ہوتے جاتے ہیں۔ یوں دولت کا چند ہاتھوں کے پاس محدود اور مرتکز ہو جانے کو ارتکازِ دولت کا مسئلہ کہا جاتا ہے۔ جس کے بہت سے معاشی، سماجی، اخلاقی اور سیاسی نقصانات ہیں۔ اسلام نے دولت کو چند ہاتھوں میں مرتکز ہونے کو منع فرمایا ہے، جیسا کہ ذیل کی آیت مبارکہ سے پتہ چلتا ہے: (ترجمہ) تاکہ وہ (مال) تمہارے مالداروں ہی کے درمیان گردش نہ کرتا رہے۔ (الحشر: 7)

paras.text: (continued from p.282) … is. Although it is the duty of an Islamic government that it make the distribution of wealth in society just and equal and make better arrangements of food, dress and housing for the poor class, nevertheless according to Islamic teachings it is obligatory on the people whose resources are less and whose earning little, that they make utmost economic effort and struggle, but pass their life with simplicity and economy and act with patience and contentment. They have absolutely no permission to adopt haram and wrongful methods for obtaining wealth, because by earning a livelihood by an impermissible means the conscience of a man reproaches him and the prick of sin always keeps him restless. On the contrary, by passing life with simplicity and patience and contentment a man obtains peace of heart. Allah Most High tests the people of faith in the following kinds: fear and danger, starvation, loss of life and property, loss of income and the wages of labour; He sees whether in such conditions the people of faith act with patience or not, as is in the Holy Quran: “And We will surely test you with something of fear and hunger and a loss of wealth and lives and fruits, but give good tidings to the patient” (Al-Baqarah: 155).
paras.urdu: (ص 282 سے جاری) … ہوتا ہے۔ اگرچہ ایک اسلامی حکومت کا فرض ہے کہ وہ معاشرہ میں دولت کی تقسیم کو عادلانہ اور مساویانہ بنائے اور غریب طبقہ کی خوراک، پوشاک اور رہائش کا بہتر انتظام کرے تاہم اسلامی تعلیمات کی رو سے جن لوگوں کے وسائل کم اور کمائی تھوڑی ہو ان پر واجب ہے کہ وہ حتی المقدور معاشی جدوجہد کرتے رہیں لیکن سادگی و کفایت سے گزارا کریں اور صبر و قناعت سے کام لیں۔ انہیں ہرگز یہ اجازت نہیں ہے کہ وہ دولت حاصل کرنے کے لئے حرام اور ناحق طریقے اختیار کریں کیونکہ ناجائز ذریعہ سے روزی کمانے اور دولت بڑھانے کے باعث انسان کا ضمیر لعن طعن کرتا ہے اور گناہ کی خلش اسے ہمیشہ بے قرار رکھتی ہے۔ اس کے برعکس سادگی اور صبر و قناعت سے زندگی بسر کرنے سے انسان قلبی اطمینان حاصل کرتا ہے۔ اللہ تعالیٰ اہلِ ایمان کی مندرجہ ذیل نوعیت کی آزمائش کرتا ہے: خوف و خطر، فاقہ کشی، جان و مال کا نقصان، آمدنی کا خسارہ اور مزد دیکھتا ہے کہ کیا ایسے حالات میں اہلِ ایمان صبر سے کام لیتے ہیں جیسا کہ قرآن مجید میں ہے: ”وَلَنَبْلُوَنَّکُمْ بِشَیْءٍ مِّنَ الْخَوْفِ وَالْجُوْعِ وَنَقْصٍ مِّنَ الْاَمْوَالِ وَالْاَنْفُسِ وَالثَّمَرٰتِ وَبَشِّرِ الصّٰبِرِیْنَ“ (البقرہ: 155)
paras.pashto: (له ۲۸۲ مخ دوام) … وي. که څه هم د اسلامي حکومت دنده ده چې په ټولنه کې د شتمنۍ وېش عادلانه او برابر کړي او د بېوزلې طبقې د خوراک، جامو او استوګنې ښه انتظام وکړي، خو د اسلامي لارښوونو له مخې پر هغو خلکو چې سرچینې یې لږې او ګټه یې کمه وي، واجب ده چې تر توانه اقتصادي هڅه او زیار وکړي، خو په ساده‌ګۍ او سپما ګوزاره وکړي او له صبر او قناعت کار واخلي. هغوی ته هېڅکله دا اجازه نشته چې د شتمنۍ د ترلاسه کولو لپاره حرامې او ناروا طریقې غوره کړي، ځکه په ناروا وسیله د روزي ګټلو او د شتمنۍ د زیاتولو له امله د انسان وجدان ملامتي کوي او د ګناه خلش یې تل بې‌قراره ساتي. برعکس، په ساده‌ګۍ او صبر او قناعت سره د ژوند په تېرولو انسان د زړه ډاډ ترلاسه کوي. الله تعالی مؤمنان په لاندې ډول ازموي: ډار او خطر، لوږه، د ځان او مال زیان، د عاید او مزدورۍ زیان؛ ګوري چې ایا په داسې حالاتو کې مؤمنان له صبر کار اخلي، لکه څنګه چې په قرآن مجید کې دي: ”وَلَنَبْلُوَنَّکُمْ بِشَیْءٍ مِّنَ الْخَوْفِ وَالْجُوْعِ وَنَقْصٍ مِّنَ الْاَمْوَالِ وَالْاَنْفُسِ وَالثَّمَرٰتِ وَبَشِّرِ الصّٰبِرِیْنَ“ (البقره: ۱۵۵).

paras.text: Therefore it is obligatory on man that he earns his livelihood by a halal method and spends only by a halal method. If ever he comes into contact with straitened circumstances, poverty or unemployment, then for earning he should never adopt impermissible and haram methods, but rather should act with simplicity, economy and patience, and should pray to Allah Pure that He grant deliverance from difficulties. In short, peace of heart is a very great blessing, which is obtained only from pure morals, halal earning, simplicity and economy, and patience and contentment.
paras.urdu: لہٰذا انسان پر واجب ہے کہ وہ حلال طریقے سے روزی کمائے اور حلال طریقے سے ہی خرچ کرے۔ اگر اسے کبھی تنگدستی، غربت، بے روزگاری سے واسطہ پڑ جائے تو کمائی کے لیے ہرگز ناجائز اور حرام طریقے اختیار نہیں کرنے چاہئیں بلکہ سادگی، کفایت شعاری اور صبر سے کام لینا چاہئے اور اللہ پاک سے دعا کرنی چاہئے کہ وہ اسے مشکلات سے نجات عطا فرمائے۔ غرض اطمینانِ قلب ایک بہت بڑی نعمت ہے جو پاکیزہ اخلاق، حلال کمائی، سادگی و کفایت اور صبر و قناعت سے ہی حاصل ہوتی ہے۔
paras.pashto: نو پر انسان واجب ده چې په حلاله طریقه روزي وګټي او یوازې په حلاله طریقه یې ولګوي. که کله له تنګلاسۍ، بېوزلۍ یا بې‌روزګارۍ سره مخ شي، نو د ګټې لپاره باید هېڅکله ناروا او حرامې طریقې غوره نه کړي، بلکې له ساده‌ګۍ، سپما او صبر کار واخلي او له پاک الله دعا وکړي چې له ستونزو یې وژغوري. لنډه دا چې د زړه ډاډ ډېر لوی نعمت دی چې یوازې له پاکو اخلاقو، حلالې ګټې، ساده‌ګۍ او سپما او صبر او قناعت ترلاسه کېږي.

paras.text: Bad effects on ostentatious expenditure (Implications of Ostentation)
paras.urdu: نمود و نمائش پر اخراجات کے برے اثرات (Implications of Ostentation):
paras.pashto: پر ښودنیزو لګښتونو بدې اغېزې (Implications of Ostentation)

paras.text: Wealthy and very rich people, in daily life, to show their superiority over others and to establish their pomp and grandeur, spend very much on their housing, dress, ceremonies, tourism and ostentation. Very bad effects of this conduct fall at the individual and collective level, e.g.:
paras.urdu: دولت مند اور امیر کبیر لوگ روزمرہ زندگی میں دوسروں پر اپنی برتری دکھانے نیز ٹھاٹھ باٹھ اور رعب و شان کا سکہ جمانے کے لئے اپنی رہائش، پوشاک، تقریبات، سیر و سیاحت اور نمود و نمائش پر بہت زیادہ خرچ کرتے ہیں۔ اس روش کے انفرادی اور اجتماعی سطح پر بہت برے اثرات پڑتے ہیں۔ مثلاً:
paras.pashto: شتمن او ډېر شتمن خلک په ورځني ژوند کې پر نورو د خپلې برترۍ د ښودلو او د خپل شان او شوکت د ټینګولو لپاره پر خپله استوګنه، جامو، مراسمو، سیل و سیاحت او ښودنه ډېر لګښت کوي. د دې روش په انفرادي او ټولنیزه کچه ډېرې بدې اغېزې لوېږي، لکه:

paras.text: (i) This is a form of extravagance, of which there is strict prohibition in Islam, and the extravagant has been declared the brother of the devil.
paras.urdu: (i) یہ فضول خرچی کی ایک شکل ہے، جس کی اسلام میں سخت ممانعت ہے اور فضول خرچ کو شیطان کا بھائی قرار دیا گیا ہے۔
paras.pashto: (i) دا د اسراف یوه بڼه ده چې په اسلام کې یې سخت ممانعت دی، او اسراف کوونکی د شیطان ورور ګڼل شوی.

paras.text: (ii) Extravagance is synonymous with wasting money, because nothing is obtained from it, whereas many useful works can be done with this amount.
paras.urdu: (ii) فضول خرچی روپیہ کو ضائع کرنے کے مترادف ہے کیونکہ اس سے کچھ حاصل نہیں ہوتا جبکہ اس رقم سے کئی مفید کام کئے جا سکتے ہیں۔
paras.pashto: (ii) اسراف د پیسو له ضایع کولو سره برابر دی، ځکه له هغه څه نه ترلاسه کېږي، حال دا چې په دې پیسو ډېر ګټور کارونه کېدای شي.

paras.text: (iii) A sense of inferiority arises within the poor class and they become victims of psychological diseases.
paras.urdu: (iii) غریب طبقہ کے اندر احساسِ کمتری پیدا ہوتا ہے اور وہ نفسیاتی امراض کا شکار ہو جاتے ہیں۔
paras.pashto: (iii) په بېوزله طبقه کې د کموالي احساس پیدا کېږي او هغوی د رواني ناروغیو ښکار کېږي.

paras.text: (iv) Society is divided into two groups, rich and poor, and between both these feelings arise, e.g. envy, rivalry, hatred, enmity, clash, unrest, riots etc.
paras.urdu: (iv) معاشرہ دو گروہوں میں تقسیم ہو جاتا ہے: امیر اور غریب اور دونوں کے درمیان کر یہ جذبات پیدا ہوتے ہیں مثلاً: حسد، رقابت، نفرت، دشمنی، تصادم، بدامنی، فسادات وغیرہ۔
paras.pashto: (iv) ټولنه په دوو ډلو وېشل کېږي: شتمن او بېوزله، او د دواړو ترمنځ دا احساسات پیدا کېږي، لکه حسد، سیالي، کرکه، دښمني، ټکر، ناامني، ګډوډۍ او نور.

paras.text: Instead of extravagance, if money is put into construction and development works and investment, then from it the income of the country increases, employment opportunities become more, poverty becomes less, and the country becomes prosperous as a whole.
paras.urdu: فضول خرچی کے بجائے اگر روپیہ کو تعمیری و ترقیاتی کاموں اور سرمایہ کاری پر لگایا جائے تو اس سے ملک کی آمدنی بڑھتی ہے، روزگار کے مواقع زیادہ ہوتے ہیں، غربت کم ہوتی ہے، اور ملک مجموعی طور پر خوشحال ہو جاتا ہے۔
paras.pashto: د اسراف پر ځای که پیسې پر جوړونیزو او پراختیايي کارونو او پانګونه ولګول شي، نو له هغو د هېواد عاید زیاتېږي، د روزګار فرصتونه زیاتېږي، بېوزلي کمېږي، او هېواد په ټولیز ډول هوسا کېږي.

paras.text: Behind israf (i.e. extravagance) there are generally these motives (Motives): income obtained from impermissible means, the concentration of wealth in a few hands, heedlessness and shortcoming in paying zakat and charities, goods of adornment and decoration for display of pomp and grandeur, use of expensive ornaments, wasteful pursuits, e.g. gambling, horse racing, drinking etc.
paras.urdu: اسراف (یعنی فضول خرچی) کے پیچھے عموماً یہ محرکات (Motives) ہوتے ہیں: ناجائز ذرائع سے حاصل کردہ آمدنی، چند ہاتھوں میں دولت کا ارتکاز، زکوٰۃ و صدقات کی ادائیگی سے غفلت اور کوتاہی، ٹھاٹھ باٹھ اور شان و شوکت کے اظہار کے لئے زیب و زینت کا سامان، قیمتی زیورات کا استعمال، فضول مشاغل مثلاً قمار بازی، گھوڑ دوڑ، شراب نوشی وغیرہ۔
paras.pashto: د اسراف (یعنې بې‌ځایه لګښت) شاته عموماً دا انګېزې (Motives) وي: له ناروا سرچینو ترلاسه شوی عاید، په څو لاسونو کې د شتمنۍ تمرکز، د زکات او صدقو په ورکړه کې غفلت او کوتاهي، د شان او شوکت د ښودلو لپاره د ښکلا او سینګار سامان، د قیمتي ګاڼو کارونه، بې‌ځایه مشغولیتونه، لکه قمار، د اسونو منډې، شراب څښل او نور.

paras.text: Effects and harms of hoarding (Implications of Hoarding)
paras.urdu: ذخیرہ اندوزی کے اثرات و مضرات (Implications of Hoarding):
paras.pashto: د احتکار اغېزې او زیانونه (Implications of Hoarding)

paras.text: By hoarding is meant holding back some agricultural commodity (wheat, rice, gram etc.) or industrial product (cloth, sugar, cement etc.) or some other thing from sale for some period and storing it, so that in the market a shortage (Shortage) of that thing occurs and the price rises, and then by selling at a high price more profit be earned. This act is in no way permissible, and from the Islamic, moral, economic and social point of view there is no permission for it; … (continued on p.284)
paras.urdu: ذخیرہ اندوزی سے مراد ہے کسی زرعی جنس (گندم، چاول، چنے وغیرہ) یا صنعتی پیداوار (کپڑا، چینی، سیمنٹ وغیرہ) یا کوئی اور شے کچھ عرصہ کے لئے فروخت کرنے سے روک لینا اور ذخیرہ کر لینا تاکہ بازار میں اس شے کی قلت (Shortage) ہو جائے اور قیمت بڑھ جائے تو پھر بلند قیمت پر بیچ کر زیادہ منافع کمایا جائے۔ یہ عمل کسی طرح جائز نہیں اور اسلامی، اخلاقی، معاشی اور معاشرتی لحاظ سے اس کی اجازت نہیں، … (ص 284 پر جاری)
paras.pashto: له احتکار مراد کوم کرنیز جنس (غنم، وریجې، نخود او نور) یا صنعتي تولید (ټوکر، بوره، سیمنټ او نور) یا کوم بل شی د یوې مودې لپاره له پلور منع کول او ذخیره کول دي، تر څو په بازار کې د هغه شي کمښت (Shortage) راشي او بیه لوړه شي، او بیا په لوړه بیه وپلورل شي او ډېره ګټه وګټل شي. دا کار په هېڅ ډول روا نه دی، او له اسلامي، اخلاقي، اقتصادي او ټولنیز پلوه یې اجازه نشته؛ … (په ۲۸۴ مخ دوام)

(continued from p.282) … is. Although it is the duty of an Islamic government that it make the distribution of wealth in society just and equal and make better arrangements of food, dress and housing for the poor class, nevertheless according to Islamic teachings it is obligatory on the people whose resources are less and whose earning little, that they make utmost economic effort and struggle, but pass their life with simplicity and economy and act with patience and contentment. They have absolutely no permission to adopt haram and wrongful methods for obtaining wealth, because by earning a livelihood by an impermissible means the conscience of a man reproaches him and the prick of sin always keeps him restless. On the contrary, by passing life with simplicity and patience and contentment a man obtains peace of heart. Allah Most High tests the people of faith in the following kinds: fear and danger, starvation, loss of life and property, loss of income and the wages of labour; He sees whether in such conditions the people of faith act with patience or not, as is in the Holy Quran: “And We will surely test you with something of fear and hunger and a loss of wealth and lives and fruits, but give good tidings to the patient” (Al-Baqarah: 155).

Therefore it is obligatory on man that he earns his livelihood by a halal method and spends only by a halal method. If ever he comes into contact with straitened circumstances, poverty or unemployment, then for earning he should never adopt impermissible and haram methods, but rather should act with simplicity, economy and patience, and should pray to Allah Pure that He grant deliverance from difficulties. In short, peace of heart is a very great blessing, which is obtained only from pure morals, halal earning, simplicity and economy, and patience and contentment.

Bad effects on ostentatious expenditure (Implications of Ostentation)

Wealthy and very rich people, in daily life, to show their superiority over others and to establish their pomp and grandeur, spend very much on their housing, dress, ceremonies, tourism and ostentation. Very bad effects of this conduct fall at the individual and collective level, e.g.:

(i) This is a form of extravagance, of which there is strict prohibition in Islam, and the extravagant has been declared the brother of the devil.

(ii) Extravagance is synonymous with wasting money, because nothing is obtained from it, whereas many useful works can be done with this amount.

(iii) A sense of inferiority arises within the poor class and they become victims of psychological diseases.

(iv) Society is divided into two groups, rich and poor, and between both these feelings arise, e.g. envy, rivalry, hatred, enmity, clash, unrest, riots etc.

Instead of extravagance, if money is put into construction and development works and investment, then from it the income of the country increases, employment opportunities become more, poverty becomes less, and the country becomes prosperous as a whole.

Behind israf (i.e. extravagance) there are generally these motives (Motives): income obtained from impermissible means, the concentration of wealth in a few hands, heedlessness and shortcoming in paying zakat and charities, goods of adornment and decoration for display of pomp and grandeur, use of expensive ornaments, wasteful pursuits, e.g. gambling, horse racing, drinking etc.

Effects and harms of hoarding (Implications of Hoarding)

By hoarding is meant holding back some agricultural commodity (wheat, rice, gram etc.) or industrial product (cloth, sugar, cement etc.) or some other thing from sale for some period and storing it, so that in the market a shortage (Shortage) of that thing occurs and the price rises, and then by selling at a high price more profit be earned. نمود و نمائش پر اخراجات کے برے اثرات (Implications of Ostentation):

فضول خرچی کے بجائے اگر روپیہ کو تعمیری و ترقیاتی کاموں اور سرمایہ کاری پر لگایا جائے تو اس سے ملک کی آمدنی بڑھتی ہے، روزگار کے مواقع زیادہ ہوتے ہیں، غربت کم ہوتی ہے، اور ملک مجموعی طور پر خوشحال ہو جاتا ہے۔

ذخیرہ اندوزی کے اثرات و مضرات (Implications of Hoarding):

(continued from p.282) … is. Although it is the duty of an Islamic government that it make the distribution of wealth in society just and equal and make better arrangements of food, dress and housing for the poor class, nevertheless according to Islamic teachings it is obligatory on the people whose resources are less and whose earning little, that they make utmost economic effort and struggle, but pass their life with simplicity and economy and act with patience and contentment. They have absolutely no permission to adopt haram and wrongful methods for obtaining wealth, because by earning a livelihood by an impermissible means the conscience of a man reproaches him and the prick of sin always keeps him restless. On the contrary, by passing life with simplicity and patience and contentment a man obtains peace of heart. Allah Most High tests the people of faith in the following kinds: fear and danger, starvation, loss of life and property, loss of income and the wages of labour; He sees whether in such conditions the people of faith act with patience or not, as is in the Holy Quran: “And We will surely test you with something of fear and hunger and a loss of wealth and lives and fruits, but give good tidings to the patient” (Al-Baqarah: 155).

Therefore it is obligatory on man that he earns his livelihood by a halal method and spends only by a halal method. If ever he comes into contact with straitened circumstances, poverty or unemployment, then for earning he should never adopt impermissible and haram methods, but rather should act with simplicity, economy and patience, and should pray to Allah Pure that He grant deliverance from difficulties. In short, peace of heart is a very great blessing, which is obtained only from pure morals, halal earning, simplicity and economy, and patience and contentment.

Bad effects on ostentatious expenditure (Implications of Ostentation)

Wealthy and very rich people, in daily life, to show their superiority over others and to establish their pomp and grandeur, spend very much on their housing, dress, ceremonies, tourism and ostentation. Very bad effects of this conduct fall at the individual and collective level, e.g.:

(i) This is a form of extravagance, of which there is strict prohibition in Islam, and the extravagant has been declared the brother of the devil.

(ii) Extravagance is synonymous with wasting money, because nothing is obtained from it, whereas many useful works can be done with this amount.

(iii) A sense of inferiority arises within the poor class and they become victims of psychological diseases.

(iv) Society is divided into two groups, rich and poor, and between both these feelings arise, e.g. envy, rivalry, hatred, enmity, clash, unrest, riots etc.

Instead of extravagance, if money is put into construction and development works and investment, then from it the income of the country increases, employment opportunities become more, poverty becomes less, and the country becomes prosperous as a whole.

Behind israf (i.e. extravagance) there are generally these motives (Motives): income obtained from impermissible means, the concentration of wealth in a few hands, heedlessness and shortcoming in paying zakat and charities, goods of adornment and decoration for display of pomp and grandeur, use of expensive ornaments, wasteful pursuits, e.g. gambling, horse racing, drinking etc.

Effects and harms of hoarding (Implications of Hoarding)

By hoarding is meant holding back some agricultural commodity (wheat, rice, gram etc.) or industrial product (cloth, sugar, cement etc.) or some other thing from sale for some period and storing it, so that in the market a shortage (Shortage) of that thing occurs and the price rises, and then by selling at a high price more profit be earned. This act is in no way permissible, and from the Islamic, moral, economic and social point of view there is no permission for it; … (continued on p.284)
